name: AI Companion Engine (PlayerEngine fork)
description: Autonomous player-agent engine: pathfinding, world interaction, inventory and task planning for a program-controlled player. A NeoVetta fork of Goodbird-git/PlayerEngine, which builds on Baritone for pathfinding. Player2 cloud services (account login, heartbeat, hosted API) are removed: it sends no telemetry and contacts no service of its own. Its only network requests go to the LLM, embeddings and text-to-speech endpoints the user configures in AI Companion. Bundled inside AI Companion and not intended to be installed on its own.
contributors: The Baritone authors — pathfinding and automation layer (LGPL-3.0)
The AltoClef authors — task and command framework (MIT)
